counterfactual_missing_items: No clear evidence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease exacerbation
No mention of alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
decisive_items: Severe emphysema and bullous changes throughout the lungs
Large bulla at posterior left lower lung measuring almost 18 cm
response.rationale: R6 is the champion because it directly matches the imaging findings of severe emphysema and bullous changes, while R7, although similar, is more focused on the broader context of COPD and smoking history.

rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence linking substance use to pneumothorax
Respiratory depression is not the primary diagnosis
Too narrow, as it only considers smoking-related emphysema
Spontaneous pneumothorax is possible but not the most comprehensive diagnosis
